reader_no_docs_origin: This server has no separate documents origin, so the preview cannot be shown.
reader_agent_needs_desktop: The agent needs the LibrePaper desktop app.
reader_source_rendering: The source changed and the current page is still rendering. Your selection is kept; retry after the page updates.
reader_source_moved: The source changed since this passage was selected. Wait for the current page to finish rendering, then select the passage again; the draft is kept.
reader_select_passage_first: Select the passage in the editor first.
reader_attach_failed: That passage could not be attached to this comment.
reader_tracking_failed: Track changes could not be turned on: this document is not connected for editing.
reader_change_file: The file of this change cannot be opened in the current paper.
reader_save_delayed: This server is busy saving; your work is kept here and will be saved shortly.
reader_chat_refused: The server rejected that chat message.
reader_passage_changed: That passage changed before the comment could be attached.
reader_stale_selection: The page changed while that comment was being placed. It has been refreshed to the current text; reselect the passage and try again.
reader_change_refused: The server refused that change. Nothing on screen has changed.
reader_open_failed: This document could not be opened.
reader_offline_local_copy: Offline. This is the copy saved in this browser, and it may be missing changes made elsewhere.
reader_offline_kept_locally: Offline; changes are kept in this browser while reconnecting…
reader_still_connecting: The current document is still connecting. Please retry when it has loaded.
